title: Potato's Cat Paintings
description: A mod that adds numerous cat paintings!
body:
Do you like cats? I know I do! This mod adds a bunch of new paintings that feature... cats! (That I might or might not have stolen from google.)

![In-Game Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0899d352a3e043e5885b1bd9c2741810057fd487_0.webp)

Notice: This mod is fairly new, so it only adds 13 paintings so far! But, I'm still working on it and I plan to add more paintings in the futre!
